direction: Cobalt and coral network atlas: a community’s persistent address and archive travel from a central provider to plural hosts; routing, a visible recommendation dial and bounded introduction gate become narrative objects. Distinct topology changes carry the argument; no decorative mesh wallpaper.
typography: Bundled Red Hat Display headings and short labels; Red Hat Text current-sentence captions.
principle: Object-specific labels only, no competing secondary slogans; physical changes represent consequences, not decorative ambient motion.
sourceImages: Community memory moving between hosts, user-governed recommendation and trust-gated introduction adapt the source architecture diagrams at conceptual level.
themes: Flat Color, Light, Dark independently checked in QA.
